# Proverbs 7 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 7:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Keep my-commandments and-live, and-my-teaching like-[the]-apple-of your-eyes. |
| LOGOS | Keep my commandments and live; keep my teaching as the apple of your eye. |
| PNEUMA | Follow my guidance and you will live. Guard my teaching the way you guard your own eyesight. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
